Homework exercise · Week 2

Shape Gallery

Scratch (offline app) Work in pairs

Goal: draw a triangle, a square and a hexagon in a row, with no lines joining them. Time: about 10 minutes. Tool: Scratch app (offline) with the Pen extension.

Build steps

  1. Open Scratch. Click Add Extension and choose Pen. Set the cat's Size to 40.
  2. Build the script below. Fill in the two missing hexagon numbers (rule: turn = 360 ÷ sides).
  3. Click the green flag. Save as shape-gallery.

The script in words

  • when green flag clicked
  • erase all
  • point in direction 90
  • pen up
  • go to x: -200 y: 50
  • pen down
  • repeat 3: move 80 steps, turn right 120 degrees
  • pen up
  • go to x: -60 y: 50
  • pen down
  • repeat 4: move 80 steps, turn right 90 degrees
  • pen up
  • go to x: 80 y: 50
  • pen down
  • repeat ?: move 50 steps, turn right ? degrees
  • pen up

Expected behavior

When you click the green flag, the stage is cleared and three closed shapes appear in a row: a triangle on the left, a square in the middle and a hexagon on the right. There are no lines between the shapes.

Checklist

Stuck? Open a hint

Try on your own first. Hints open one at a time, from a small nudge to a bigger one. None of them gives the answer away.

Hint 1: Where to look

Look at the two question marks in the hexagon part. They are the number of repeats and the turn. The triangle and the square above it show you the pattern. Think about how many sides a hexagon has.

Hint 2: Try this

The rule is turn = 360 ÷ sides. The repeat number is the same as the number of sides. Use your calculator or the Operators category to work out the turn.

Hint 3: Almost there

Fill in the last block like this: repeat ( ) with the number of sides in the hole, then turn right ( ) degrees with 360 ÷ ( ) worked out. Make sure pen up comes before each go to, so no lines join the shapes.
